title: The Archive's Hotel Spine Stack

features.name: room-223
features.desc-on-touch: A motel room facade where the same night learned to book itself again and again in different years.

features.name: elevator-lattice
features.desc-on-touch: The wireframe shaft rising through all floors at once, containing every arrival that ever climbed or fell.

features.name: number-tower
features.desc-on-touch: Room numbers stacked and restacked: 101, 102, 103... but also 101, 102, 103 again in different colors, different years.

features.name: ice-machine-pool
features.desc-on-touch: The perpetual low hum where machines dispense cold into the hallway; guests mill around it like fish to a pool.

features.name: linen-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Clean towels and sheets stacked by someone who checked in long ago; the same housekeeping, the same folds, layered through decades.

features.name: motel-sign-plaque
features.desc-on-touch: The neon sign carved as text; its letters drift between names of motels that never existed and motels that are still dreaming.

inscription: each floor holds the same night learning to be different; the stairs don't care which version you're climbing

file.name: Room_Register_Spine_AllYears.env
file.note: Guest names from every year the motel operated overlaid into one ledger, arrivals and departures bleeding into each other's slots
